en:
<CLT=cltMIND>We decided to hang out
in the gym.

<CLT=cltMIND>It looks like we're the only ones here...
What should we do?
Let's burn this place to the ground

Even if it isn't tennis...I've had my 
fill of aiming balls at people.

Then you need to plan an 
efficient training program...
I'll teach you everything I know.

If you get thrown in jail for that, it
would make your loved ones sad...
Unlike me, you have people like that...

<CLT=cltMIND>I wonder what's wrong?
Ryoma looks deep in thought...
